BUT it's not intuitive to me how off-boarding will happen to anything other than non-bearer assets in the full blown financial armageddon you're describing... Think of the second order effects in your scenario; our system is run on debt and leverage, so with banks blowing up, and counterparty risk in the opaque Tradfi world... that means anything up for grabs. So why hold anything other than a non-bearer asset? Such as BTC, physical precious metals?
